note: Sections only, from eval --bars/--lines. A 16-bar block of repeated lines (each twice in the song) sung over a building beat = chorus (its first bars may be a pre-chorus); loud unsung stretch after it = drop. Near-silent 2 bars before verse 2. After chorus 2: new long lines (bridge), 8 instrumental bars rising into the last drop (the chorus' last line held over the gap bar).
